verdict.rationale: The evidence shows several Scribe models: Scribe v2, Scribe v2 Realtime with a sub-150 ms latency claim, and a variant claiming 35% fewer clinical errors than v2. It also shows a vendor accuracy chart and Scribe v2 pricing. However, there is no consolidated comparison of accuracy, latency and cost across models, and no documented model-selection parameter. missing for 10: documented model-selection parameter in the API, side-by-side tradeoff table, pricing and latency for each model, independent accuracy benchmarks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs

citations.quote: Scribe v2 Realtime captures live speech in under 150 ms with exceptional accuracy
35% fewer transcription errors on clinical audio than Scribe v2
